meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会结合项目的知识图谱分析代码改动,告诉你改了哪些部分、可能影响哪些模块和架构层次,并评估风险,最后生成一份差异总览文件供可视化展示。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 Git 差异或 Pull Request 的改动内容时触发;使用前需先有 .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json(否则会提示先执行 /understand)。

say.text: 分析一下当前分支的改动影响了哪些模块
say.note: 会基于知识图谱给出受影响组件

say.text: 看看这个 Pull Request 改了哪些组件,风险高不高
say.note: 会评估跨层影响和风险等级

say.text: 对比 main 分支,告诉我这次改动的受影响层
say.note: 会列出受影响的架构层次

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes code changes against the project's knowledge graph, reports what changed, which components and architectural layers are affected, assesses risks, and writes a diff overlay file for dashboard visualization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze git diffs or pull requests. Requires an existing .understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json; otherwise Claude asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Analyze which modules are affected by the current branch's changes.
say_en.note: Lists affected components from the graph.

say_en.text: Look at this pull request—what changed and how risky is it?
Compare with main and tell me the affected layers.
